AstroScout helps you find the best spot for astrophotography by combining light pollution, astronomical weather and nearby parking.
Warning: no DarkSkySites API key is configured. Light pollution values come from a simplified SIMULATION and must not be used to plan real sessions.

Astro Score = 100 × Σ(weight × sub-score) / Σ(weights). Light pollution: linear on SQM from 17.5 to 22.0 mag/arcsec². Clouds: 1 − mean cover over the night window (0 if precipitation). Seeing and transparency: (8 − 7Timer! index) / 7. With cover ≥ 80% or precipitation the score is capped at 20.
